index.title: Exception Management
index.desc: Items assessed as vulnerable but temporarily exempted for operational reasons. Takes effect only after approval. Extend or remediate in advance when expiry is near.
index.searchPh: 🔍 Search rule ID / host / reason / requester / approver

js.rejectRequired: A reason is required to reject.

new.title: New Exception Request
new.heading: New Exception Request (Batch)
new.desc: Temporary exception for items assessed as vulnerable. Takes effect after CISO approval. Register check items × targets (hosts/accounts) at once.

post.heading: Post-hoc Exception Target
post.serverScopeHtml: Apply exception to this entire server (host) (host-level)
post.noAccounts: Could not find the account list for this server (no raw script assessment output). Enter or paste accounts below.

basic.heading: ① Basic Info
basic.titlePh: e.g. E-Financial Infrastructure 2026 OS batch exceptions (2026 Q1)
basic.basisPh: Basis for the exception (assessment result ID, approval ticket no., related regulations/documents, review minutes, etc.) — for audit trail and post-hoc filtering

items.heading: ② Select Check Items
items.searchPh: Search by SRV code or title...

target.heading: ③ Targets (Host · Account)
target.hostPh: Search/select (hostname/IP). Leave empty for CSV batch
target.acctPh: Account-level only (e.g. jessy72). Wildcard * allowed (e.g. test*). Leave empty for whole host
target.csvPh:
hostname,account  (one per line)
jessy207,jessy72
jessy207,test*
jessy167,   ← empty account = whole host
target.csvHelpBefore: Apply exceptions for the selected check items to multiple hosts/accounts at once.
target.csvHelpAfter: · (CSV input overrides the single host/account above)

reason.heading: Exception Reason
reason.detailPh: Specific reason why an exception is required
reason.compPh: Risk-mitigating controls (firewall blocking, enhanced monitoring, etc.)

period.heading: Validity Period
period.note: Recommended 30–90 days. Indefinite applies permanently without an end date.

js.alertNeedItem: Select at least one check item.
